markitdown.purpose: Optional converter for external PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, image, audio, ZIP, and URL sources before they enter 00_raw.
markitdown.enable_condition: Set MERCURY_MARKITDOWN_ENABLED=true and make Python 3.10+ available.
markitdown.default_policy: Do not use in the core V8-Mercury flow unless source material is not already markdown or plain text.

gbrain.purpose: Optional external agent brain target. Mercury Lab emits pre-audit bundles but does not import or write to gbrain by default.
gbrain.default_policy: Use Mercury Lab as memory hygiene before gbrain-owned ingestion.

mercury_agent_second_brain.purpose: Optional Mercury Agent Second Brain target. Mercury Lab emits reviewed import candidates without writing to runtime SQLite directly.
mercury_agent_second_brain.default_policy: Use schema-aware adapters only; never bypass the runtime memory owner.
